# Mytetz

> Mytetz is a learning app. A reader picks a topic from a curated catalogue and studies it in a focused, guided reader.

The catalogue lists topics by title, category and summary. A reader can search, filter, then start a session that opens the topic in the reader.

## Pages

- [Catalogue](https://mytetz.com/): the curated list of topics.
- [How it works](https://mytetz.com/how-it-works): which model writes an explanation, the known limits, and a contact.
- [FAQ](https://mytetz.com/faq): the price, the trial, and cancellation.
- [Privacy policy](https://mytetz.com/privacy)
- [Terms of service](https://mytetz.com/terms)
- [Imprint](https://mytetz.com/imprint)

## Product

- Price: $12 a month, through a Freemius checkout. The trial needs no card.
- Trial: 40 explanations over 7 days, no credit card.
- Subscriber allowance: 25 explanations each day.
- Cancel: the account page, Manage subscription.
- No account is needed for the catalogue, a topic page and its seed text.

## Guides

Editorial pages about self-study. Every claim names a primary source, with the year and the sample size.

- [Study guides](https://mytetz.com/guides): twelve guides below.
- [How to study on your own](https://mytetz.com/guides/how-to-study-on-your-own): a six-step loop.
- [What to use instead of a highlighter](https://mytetz.com/guides/what-to-use-instead-of-a-highlighter)
- [How to test yourself while you read](https://mytetz.com/guides/how-to-test-yourself-while-you-read)
- [When to review what you read](https://mytetz.com/guides/when-to-review-what-you-read)
- [How students study now](https://mytetz.com/guides/how-students-study-now): 2026 survey data.
- [Why a person stops an online course](https://mytetz.com/guides/why-a-person-stops-an-online-course)
- [How to understand a difficult text](https://mytetz.com/guides/how-to-understand-a-difficult-text)
- [How to use AI to study without cheating](https://mytetz.com/guides/how-to-use-ai-to-study-without-cheating)
- [How to explain a text to yourself](https://mytetz.com/guides/how-to-explain-a-text-to-yourself-while-you-read)
- [How many times to reread something](https://mytetz.com/guides/how-many-times-should-you-reread-something)
